body: DJ Akademiks shared an Instagram video showing Lil Durk in court right before his verdict was read, via @iamchicity. The post, published September 12, 2026, has garnered 7,515 likes and 428 comments. This update comes as Durk's legal case continues to dominate hip-hop discourse.
